shortDefinition: An AI system that can plan, use tools, and execute multi-step tasks autonomously.
fullDefinition: An AI agent is an AI system that goes beyond text generation to take real actions: searching the web, executing code, reading files, calling APIs, and completing multi-step tasks with minimal human supervision. Agents operate in a loop: observe current state, plan next action, execute, observe results, and repeat.
examples: Perplexity Deep Research — an agent that autonomously searches many sources
GitHub Copilot Workspace — a coding agent that plans and implements features
ChatGPT Tasks — an agent that executes scheduled actions on your behalf
